استعطرن (form X)
# اِسْتَعْطَرْنَ (istaʕṭarna) /is.taʕ.tˤar.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
# اِسْتَعْطِرْنَ (istaʕṭirna) /is.taʕ.tˤir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْطَرَ (istaʕṭara)
